thread:
alex: quick sync — product asked for a single dashboard that shows GPU headroom for both Hosted + Dedicated pools. want to align on signals we can expose from runtime + infra.

maria: +1. core signals we discussed last week were SM occupancy, per-SM memory, and queue depth. do we need anything else for routing/quota decisions?

tyler: latency percentiles for queued tasks (p50/p95) matter for routing decisions (fallbacks) — if queue depth is low but queued latency is high, something's odd.

samir: agree. also need per-pool aggregated metrics (pool-level) and host-level rollups for SRE debugging. cardinality will explode if we emit per-container+pool combos.

jess: from console POV we want: "Available headroom", "Active queues", "Avg SM occupancy (30s window)", and an alerting panel for "memory pressure". UX should let teams toggle between Hosted and Dedicated views.

alex: infra-bot posted ingest note: "metric: sm_occupancy_percent gauge per_sm host_id pool_id" — but i'm worried around cardinality. what aggregation keys are essential?

maria: keep host_id + pool_id for host-level, and pool_id only for pool-level metrics. runtime can emit per_sm but ingestion should roll up to `pool_id` by default.

tyler: sample metric proto suggestion: ```metrics: sm_memory_alloc_bytes{pool_id, host_id, sm_index} gauge queue_depth{pool_id} counter queued_latency_ms p50/p95 derived``` this is rough.

samir: for ingestion: downsample per_sm to 1s or 5s? 1s is ideal for heatmaps but heavy. propose 5s default, 1s for debug mode (ephemeral).

jess: retention: console only needs 30d for dashboarding; SRE wants 90d for postmortems. can we tier retention?

maria: yes; we can route high-res recent data to metrics cluster A (5s retention window hot), longer-term 1m aggregates to cluster B (90d).

alex: routing/policy integration: product wants automatic fallback when pool headroom < 10%. which metric drives that? sm_occupancy_percent 95th? or pool-level `available_sm_ratio`?

tyler: use conservative signal: pool_available_sm_ratio < 0.10 AND queued_latency_p95 > 200ms. avoids spurious fallbacks.

samir: alerting thresholds: memory pressure when sum(sm_memory_alloc_bytes)/sum(sm_memory_cap_bytes) > 0.85 for 2m. queue-depth alert when pool queue_depth > configured commitment threshold.

jess: for dashboard panels we'll need: heatmap (per-host sm occupancy), timeseries (pool-level occupancy & queue depth), and resource table (per-dedicated-customer usage).

alex: ownership question: who will own the rollup jobs + dashboard? eng-platform owns metric schema; eng-sre owns alerts; product + console owns dashboard UX. agree?
maria: yep, will document schema in the metrics repo and add owners list.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollup job `gpu-metric-rollup-v1` scheduled to prod tomorrow 04:00 UTC.

jess: can we get a canary dashboard first? small prod only shows one dedicated tenant + hosted sample.

tyler: +1 for canary. samir, can you add a canary flag to rollup so it only processes pool_id in ["dedicated-canary-1","hosted-sample-1"]?

samir: yep can do. will also enable 1s sampling for those pools.

alex: action items: (1) runtime emits proto with keys (pool_id, host_id, sm_index) and tags we agreed, (2) eng-platform add rollup job with downsampling rules, (3) eng-sre draft alert thresholds, (4) console build canary dashboard. i'll own the doc.

maria: i'll open PR for schema + examples.

jess: i'll mock the canary dashboard tomorrow and post screenshots. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all — follow-up doc link when PR up.
